title: 刑场上的骂名
speaker: 小炭火旁白
line: 谢却山，城里人人喊打的叛徒。
visual: Execution courtyard at cold lavender dawn. Left wide: adult general in navy robes wrists chained standing before distant crowd, no torture. Middle close-up his calm refined unmasked face with windblown black hair. Right female heroine in crowd worried amber eyes, hands gripping crimson cloak. Grim situation but luminous romantic anime, no gore.

title: 疑问
speaker: 小炭火对白
line: 你明明救了他们，为什么不解释？
visual: Flashback violet twilight palace corridor. Left two-shot girl approaches unmasked general in navy robes with silver shoulder armour. Middle close-up girl asking him earnestly, beautiful orange-gold hair and amber eyes, natural expressive lips. Right his quiet listening profile lit by her warm flame, restrained hurt.

title: 密信
speaker: 小炭火旁白
line: 直到我找到，那封通敌的密信。
visual: Night study, girl investigates alone. Left she opens wooden desk hidden drawer. Middle hands unfolding old sealed letter red wax, handwritten indistinct ink no readable text. Right girl face shocked near candle, orange hair softly glowing. Violet moon through lattice.

title: 质问
speaker: 小炭火对白
visual: Same night study. Left girl holds opened letter facing general who has entered. Middle close-up girl raising letter asking serious quiet question, hero out of focus foreground. Right male refined face in cool blue shadow, silent steady eyes. Fixed costumes, tense emotional beauty.

title: 另一面
speaker: 谢却山对白
line: 是我。可你还没看见另一面。
visual: Same study. Left general looks down at the letter held by girl. Middle close-up male speaking calmly and sadly, unmasked black ponytail navy-silver outfit. Right shadow of approaching enemy visible beyond lattice door while his eyes turn toward it. No duplicate hero.

title: 破门接敌
speaker: 谢却山对白
visual: Night corridor ambush. Left door bursts inward one enemy with saber approaches from right, hero steps before heroine. Middle hero draws one straight sword right-handed to parry incoming saber with gold sparks. Right hero pushes blade aside and steps toward exit, heroine follows holding letter. Beautiful fast physical action, no gore.

title: 突围
speaker: 小炭火旁白
line: 他挡在我身前，却不肯替自己辩白。
visual: Palace courtyard violet twilight and gold lanterns. Left hero strides to meet single red-plumed enemy, heroine behind clutching letter. Middle medium two-shot blades clash clearly then hero turns waist to deflect. Right enemy recoils after sword pommel strike, heroine and hero move toward open gate. Crisp continuous fight elegant body mechanics.

title: 伤痕
speaker: 小炭火对白
line: 这些伤，也是你不能说的秘密？
visual: Sheltered ruined shrine candlelight. Left general seated removing silver shoulder guard, navy inner robe loose only at shoulder revealing healed scars no blood. Middle heroine face compassionate asking while pressing folded white cloth to injured shoulder. Right close-up his hand resting on folded letter, emotional amber and violet light.

title: 山河破碎
speaker: 谢却山对白
line: 我见过山河破碎，见过百姓流离。
visual: Same shrine. Left medium two-shot seated injured general and kneeling heroine. Middle close-up male unmasked solemn speaking, warm candle on face cool background. Right transition image ruined distant city behind smoke and refugees walking with children, no graphic injury. Elegant melancholic anime.

title: 潜入敌营
speaker: 小炭火旁白
line: 所以，他选择潜入敌营，背上骂名。
visual: Flashback enemy military camp blue violet night. Left masked general black silver armour arrives before enemy tent. Middle he bows head slightly before enemy commander in silhouette, hands controlled. Right close-up his hand secretly conceals folded evacuation map beneath dark cape, eyes watchful. No readable words.

title: 战场号令
speaker: 谢却山对白
visual: Epic ancient city battle blue violet twilight amber fire. Left wide few mounted cavalry approach city gate dust and banners, main general identifiable black silver armour. Middle masked general close-up on black horse delivering order urgently, lips visible below eye mask. Right wide refugees hurry through gate protected by small soldier group.

title: 骑战破阵
visual: Same masked general on black horse in city approach. Left lateral tracking composition horse gallops left to right general carries ONE long spear in right hand. Middle spear shafts clash against one enemy soldier's raised polearm localized sparks, stable saddle posture. Right general clears blocked path with sweeping spear parry, enemy steps back, horse and rider continue forward. No gore no flying bodies no magic explosion.

title: 守门近战
speaker: 小炭火旁白
line: 世人只见他，向敌人低头。
visual: At narrow city gate masked general now dismounted sword in right hand. Left plants left foot and sidesteps enemy spear thrust from right. Middle presses spear shaft down with sword, pivots around enemy. Right drives sword pommel into enemy breastplate pushing enemy away. Refugees far behind gate, faces not graphic. Elegant full body movement black silver armour.

title: 护住百姓
speaker: 小炭火旁白
line: 却没看见，他把刀锋留给自己。
visual: Same battle gate. Left general sees mother and child behind him while enemy saber incoming. Middle general firmly parries saber across his body shielding civilians, cape sweeps in golden embers. Right civilians escape past camera while general stands guarding gate wounded shoulder only tiny cloth tear no gore. Hero face still refined, mask same.

title: 为自己活
speaker: 小炭火对白
line: 谢却山，你可曾为自己活过一日？
visual: Return to quiet shrine warm golden candlelight. Left heroine wraps clean bandage at male shoulder, male in navy robe silver armour removed beside him. Middle exquisite close-up girl with moist amber eyes speaking softly, hair softly lit not blazing. Right two-shot she holds his hand, male looks toward her. Intimate romantic emotional anime, adults.

title: 想活
speaker: 谢却山对白
line: 我也想活。可身后的人，不能死。
visual: Same shrine. Left adult general gently closes his hand around girl's. Middle male close-up speaking with controlled vulnerability, fine anime face black hair blue-violet eyes no tears melodrama. Right close-up girl listening, flame reflected in eyes and their joined hands lower foreground. Soft luminous warm lighting.

title: 并肩选择
speaker: 小炭火对白
visual: Shrine doorway dawn. Left heroine firmly tucks letter into red-gold sleeve. Middle heroine close-up determined gentle smile speaks to general. Right both stand side by side at open doorway, general again wears silver shoulder guards over navy robes with sword sheathed, she lights small flame to guide their road. Refined optimistic melancholic beauty.

title: 名字与悬念
speaker: 小炭火旁白
line: 他叫谢却山。背着骂名，也要护住山河。
visual: Return execution square lavender dawn. Left general wrists chained facing crowd, navy robe no armour. Middle heroine at edge of crowd raises sealed letter toward general, warm flame shines like sunrise. Right close-up general hears distant signal and lifts eyes, restrained hopeful smile, luminous gold light catches face. Suspenseful ending no execution shown.
